name: Danganronpa: Maiden Voyage
source:
All aboard the Maiden Voyage of Despair!
Sail away with the wonderful class of Hope's Peak Europe into the middle of the ocean, where the only way to evacuate is through murder.

What can you trust?

Who will get a second chance at life?

Who is pulling the string from the shadows?

Meet an all-new cast, explore an all-new world with all-new gameplay and ever-grislier murders!

[From [url=https://your-majesty.itch.io/danganronpa-maiden-voyage]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
全部登上绝望的处女航！
与欧洲希望之峰的精彩课程一起航行到大洋中央，在那里唯一的撤离方法是通过谋杀。

你能相信什么？

谁能获得第二次人生机会？

是谁在幕后拉动这根绳子？

认识全新的演员阵容，探索全新的世界，体验全新的游戏玩法和更加恐怖的谋杀！

[来自[url=https://your-majesty.itch.io/danganronpa-maiden-voyage]itch.io[/url]]
